source.methodology: Global H-1 comes from MarginPad's measured time-bucketed liquidation archive. Hyperliquid-specific H-1 is computed only from returned raw events and carries an explicit coverage status.
source.documented_market_coverage: approximately 70%+ of liquidation flow; observed, not extrapolated

global_h1.note: Summed from MarginPad time-bucketed observed liquidation archive for the requested 60-minute window.

assets.hyperliquid_source: MarginPad public collector of Hyperliquid forced-liquidation stream; secondary observed source, not Hyperliquid official REST.
